metadata.title: Free Perm Filter Online | AI Perm Filter | Toolaze
metadata.description: Try Toolaze's free AI Perm Filter online. Upload one portrait and preview soft wave, loose digital, curly bob, spiral, Korean volume, and men's perm styles.

hero.desc: Upload one clear portrait and preview what you would look like with a perm. Toolaze starts with Soft Wave Perm selected, includes women and men perm styles, hides preset prompts, and keeps Custom available for a text description or reference image.

safetyNotice: The result is a visual perm concept, not a guaranteed salon outcome. Real curls depend on hair length, density, texture, chemical process, and styling.

intro.title: What Is an AI Perm Filter?

content.title: See your curled or wavy hair before booking a perm
content.text: An AI perm filter edits the visible hairstyle in a portrait into a curled or wavy perm concept while preserving the face, expression, clothing, lighting, and background. Use it to compare soft waves, digital perm shapes, curly bob styles, spiral curls, Korean volume perms, or men's wavy perms before a salon visit.

howToUse.title: How to Use the Perm Filter

steps.title: Upload one portrait
steps.desc: Use a clear portrait where your hair length, face, and current hairline are visible.

steps.title: Choose a perm style
steps.desc: Start with Soft Wave Perm, then compare loose digital, curly bob, spiral, Korean volume, beach wave, or men's wavy perm styles.

steps.title: Generate or customize the curl direction
steps.desc: Preset styles use hidden prompts. Switch to Custom if you want tighter curls, looser waves, more root volume, or a reference hairstyle image.

photoTips.title: Photo Tips for a Better Perm Preview
photoTips.subtitle: Perm previews work best when the model can see your current hair length and face-framing shape.

items.title: Show enough hair length
items.desc: Avoid cropped photos where the sides, crown, or ends are outside the frame.

items.title: Use natural lighting
items.desc: Even light helps curls blend into the original hair and face shape.

items.title: Keep the face unobstructed
items.desc: Hair can frame the face, but sunglasses, hands, or heavy shadows make the edit less stable.

items.title: Match the style to your length
items.desc: Very short hair may not preview long spiral curls well; choose a perm style close to your current length for cleaner results.

faq.q: Is the Perm Filter free to try?
faq.a: Yes. You can open the image tool, upload one portrait, and start previewing perm styles. This is not an unlimited-use promise; generation limits or model availability may still apply.

faq.q: Which perm style is selected by default?
faq.a: Soft Wave Perm is selected by default because it is a natural starting point before comparing tighter curls or higher-volume styles.

faq.q: Can men use the Perm Filter?
faq.a: Yes. The page includes men's perm presets such as Men's Wavy Perm, Short Curly Perm, Textured Perm, and Loose Flow Perm.

faq.q: What is the difference between Perm Filter and AI Hairstyle Changer?
faq.a: AI Hairstyle Changer covers many haircut directions. Perm Filter is narrower and focuses on curled, wavy, and salon-perm looks.

faq.q: Does the preset card image get sent to the model?
faq.a: No. For built-in presets, Toolaze sends your uploaded portrait plus the hidden perm prompt. The card image only helps you choose a style.

faq.q: Can I describe a custom perm?
faq.a: Yes. Open Custom and choose Describe hair style to write curl size, volume, parting, or length. You can also use Reference hair style to upload a hairstyle reference image.

faq.q: Is the result an exact salon prediction?
faq.a: No. It is a visual concept. Real perm results depend on hair condition, length, density, previous treatments, chemical processing, and styling.
